context.body: A prelude is not automatically a fugue. Follow the texture and repeated figures. The computed cues describe local motifs only.

context.math: Compare entry delay, pitch translation, reflection and rhythmic scale. A tonal answer can alter intervals and then falls outside the exact semitone detector.
